title: Resource Qualifiers, Localisation, and Configuration Quick Check

questions.prompt: Which directory normally contains Spanish string alternatives?
questions.explanation: The locale qualifier is appended to the values resource directory.

questions.prompt: Match content to its correct treatment.
questions.explanation: Only application-owned presentation text is localised through app resources.

questions.prompt: Concatenating separately translated sentence fragments is safe for every language.
questions.explanation: Languages differ in ordering, agreement, spacing, and grammar, so translators need complete messages.
